sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
after = current_frame.segmentation

# Check white position
for n in after['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W':
        print(f"White: {n['boundary']}")

# Check bar/X
for n in after['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'R' and n['pixels'] > 10:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"R shape: pixels={n['pixels']}, rows={min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check targets
charcoal_frames = [n for n in after['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c' and n['pixels'] == 8]
print(f"Remaining targets: {len(charcoal_frames)}")
for cf in charcoal_frames:
    child_id = cf['children'][0] if cf['children'] else None
    child = None
    if child_id is not None:
        for n in after['nodes']:
            if n['id'] == child_id:
                child = n
                break
    if child:
        print(f"  {child['color']} at {child['boundary']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
